system.description: After exposing a subject to a sensation, substance, or situation, touching them and winning a Mental Challenge instantly addicts them to it. Each night without a fix forces the victim to bid an additional Trait on all challenges, worsening over time, and confronting the object of addiction requires a Static Self-Control Challenge to resist indulging. Addiction lasts a number of weeks equal to your permanent Social Traits divided by two (round down), and can only be broken by accumulating Self-Control wins exceeding your Path of Corruption rating.
system.duration: Weeks equal to permanent Social Traits / 2
